Electricity for the plant is purchased at $65.2/MWh. The cost for CO T&S was determined specifically for each 2 capture case based on CO product flow rate, a 62-mile pipeline length, and storage in the 2 Mount Simon reservoir. CO T&S costs for the study include $12.7/tonne ($11.4/ton) CO for 2 2 Case 2 and $11.6/tonne ($10.3/ton) CO for Case 3. The key cost metric used in this report is the 2 levelized cost of ammonia (LCOA), which is the revenue that must be received by the producer per tonne of ammonia produced to meet all capital and operating costs of the plant. Exhibit ES-2 shows the performance results summary and Exhibit ES-3 shows the plant power requirement breakdown by power source and equipment. Note that the non-steam-driven auxiliary loads use electricity imported from the grid. Exhibit ES-2.
